name: grndctrl-monorepo
description: Ground Control — a local-first console for your Jira tickets and the AI agents working them

scripts.typecheck: tsc --build --force && npm run typecheck:desktop && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.typecheck:desktop: tsc -p packages/desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/desktop/tsconfig.ui.json && tsc -p packages/desktop/tsconfig.e2e.json
scripts.typecheck:tests: tsc -p packages/core/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/cli/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/launcher/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.credential:import: npm run build && node packages/cli/bin/grndctrl-cli.js credential
scripts.providers:probe: npm run build && node packages/cli/bin/grndctrl-cli.js probe
